svg.aria-label: Connection diagram: browser, glue encoders, network families with hub, engine ports, memory and screen, glue commands
svg.title: Connection diagram: browser, glue encoders, network families with hub, engine ports, memory and screen, glue commands
svg.text: Measured from the shipped weight file. Amber is glue, teal is the engine and memory, and the large panel is the network.
One network. Colored panels are README categories; names are labels on its neurons
view: side scroll and vertical ruler
Laying out and painting the page
Hub: compiled control (9,468), shared registers (573), port wiring (1,302)
Engine: passive ports, driven only by network neurons
Glue: runs ticks and carries out named commands
Line numbers: measured connections between that family and the hub. Families also connect to each other directly: see the table below.
